title: The Train Can Leave Without You

segments.text: [soft, slow, warm voice] [faint distant train rumble] [softly] Find a safe pause. Imagine standing on a quiet platform while an ordinary urge approaches like a train in the distance.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Name the urge without boarding it. Wanting is here... impatience is here... a train is arriving.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel where arrival happens in the body: hands, mouth, chest, belly, legs. Notice the first vibration on the rails.
[soft, slow, warm voice] The train grows louder. Observe colour, pressure, temperature, and movement without stepping toward the door.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Thoughts may advertise the destination. Hear the announcement and remain on the platform.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [reassuringly] You do not need to fight the train. Let it be present at full size while breathing remains natural.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Notice the crest: perhaps urgency peaks, flickers, or changes location. Keep both feet connected to the ground.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [soft distant train rumble fading] Listen for the first sign of departure. It may be subtle: one loosened muscle, one quieter sentence, one second of space.
[soft, slow, warm voice] The train may linger or another may follow. Urges can repeat without becoming permanent orders.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [thoughtfully] Let your next choice come from the person on the platform, not from the loudspeaker.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [softly] Watch the red lights travel away. Feel the room around you and decide the next step in your own time.
